name: Rust & WebAssembly
description: Curated toolsets, best practices, and compiler diagnostics for Rust systems development and Wasm targets.
best_practices: Ownership idioms: Leverage borrow checker semantics and minimize cloning.
Error handling with thiserror/anyhow: Maintain type safety and contextual error tracing.
WASM compatibility: Guard native platform dependencies with conditional compilation flags.
Safe concurrency: Employ async Tokio channels instead of shared locks.
